decision_or_engineering_rationale: Evaluate multiple COTS glass-cockpit architectures against aircraft-level capability, integration, HMI, support and lifecycle factors rather than display features alone.
Use/assess an avionics data-interface path to integrate retained navigation capability with the Dynon cockpit.
Treat spare LRUs and OEM repair/support as part of the fleet support concept; do not assume all board-level repair can be performed locally.
Restore required settings and databases after display replacement before re-test/flight.
Keep qualification/certification suitability separate from functional flight performance in customer evaluation.
Keep G3X comparison evidence separate from the G900X/G950 prototype/evaluation track.
Abstract controlled implementation detail while retaining requirement-function-interface-configuration-verification traceability.
Do not represent detailed closure beyond what is included in the public release.
